metadata.title: That 1 kill Valorant said ‘Wait, you actually hit that?’ and I’m still in shock LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, how did I get that kill?
My aim was busy napping but enemy said bye.
Click if your lucky shots confuse even you!
Valorant logic strikes again!

Tap in if your aim’s on vacation but kills still happen!
